units.source_text: 此时若教生父知道，生怕反多不便。”

en.t: If her real father were told now, she feared it might instead cause many difficulties.

units.source_text: 源氏听了这话，知道她故意将他的恋情解释作父女之情，觉得此人很可怜爱。

en.t: When Genji heard this, he realized that she was deliberately interpreting his love as the affection between father and daughter, and he found her very touching and dear.

units.source_text: 玉鬘虽然如此说，心中并不作如此想。

en.t: Although Tamakazura said this, in her heart she did not really think so.

units.source_text: 她盼望源氏找个机会向她父亲说穿，等候得很心焦。

en.t: She hoped Genji would find an opportunity to explain everything to her father, and she waited for it with great impatience.

units.source_text: 然而她又回心转意：“这位太政大臣对我关怀之深，实在很可感激。

en.t: Yet then she changed her mind again: The deep concern this Grand Minister has shown me is truly something to be grateful for.

units.source_text: 现在我即使认到了父亲，但因自幼不相熟悉，深恐父亲对我的照拂不会如此周到吧。”

en.t: Even if I acknowledge my father now, since we have not been close since childhood, I fear he would not care for me so attentively.

units.source_text: 她读了些古代故事小说，渐渐懂得人情世故。

en.t: She had read some old tales and romances, and little by little came to understand human feelings and worldly affairs.

units.source_text: 因此行事小心谨慎，觉得未便自动前往寻亲。

en.t: For that reason she acted cautiously and prudently, feeling that it would be improper to go on her own to seek out her kin.
